resources.string: Sign in and select a paired Elder to view records.
Access is not yet confirmed. No records are shown. Refresh or check your Elder selection.
Access has been revoked. Select an authorized Elder through pairing.
Records are unavailable or access could not be confirmed. Check your sign-in and Elder selection, then refresh.
No local records have been loaded. Refresh to check; this does not mean there are no medication events.
No medication events in the selected dates. This is not evidence of whether medication was taken.
Records could not be fully updated. Last known records are retained when available. Try refreshing again.
Offline. Showing local records when available; refresh after reconnecting.
Out of date — these records may have changed.
Reminder capability: unknown. This does not indicate a medication outcome or device connectivity.
Last reported reminder capability: %1$s. Observed (device time zone): %2$s. This is not a live connection check.

Notification permission: %1$s
Notification channel: %2$s
Exact alarm access: %3$s
Capability report received by service (device time zone): %4$s
Local storage is unavailable. Records could not be fully updated; last known records may be out of date. Try refreshing again later.
The refresh request is invalid. Check the selected Elder and dates before trying again. Last known records may be out of date.
The requested dates or number of records exceed the download limit. No shortened result is shown. Try a smaller date range; last known records may be out of date.
The service is temporarily unavailable. Last known records may be out of date. Try refreshing again later.
The service has asked you to retry later. Last known records may be out of date. Wait before refreshing again.
